title: DGF-Asym: Adaptive Peer Weighting for Collective Estimation under Noisy and Faulty Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2611.22532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collective estimation under unreliable sensing requires robots to adaptively balance personal observations and social information from peers. We propose DGF-Asym, a decentralized collective estimation method extending the DeGroot-Friedkin model with asymmetric peer weighting based on retrospective predictive performance. The method supports consensus formation without prior sensor-noise statistics or explicit fault models while keeping inter-robot communication asynchronous. We evaluate DGF-Asym in simulated collective navigation under noisy observations and time-varying sensor faults. Compared with three baselines, it produces more stable estimates and more reliably sustains the decision criterion, at the cost of longer decision times. However, overall performance depends on fault ratio, group size, and influence-threshold selection. translated_title: DGF-Asym：面向噪声与故障感知下集体估计的自适应同伴加权方法
translated_abstract: 在不可靠感知条件下的集体估计要求机器人自适应地平衡自身观测与来自同伴的社会信息。我们提出了DGF-Asym，一种去中心化的集体估计方法，它扩展了DeGroot-Friedkin模型，引入了基于回顾性预测性能的非对称同伴加权机制。该方法无需先验的传感器噪声统计或显式故障模型即可支持共识形成，同时保持机器人间通信的异步性。我们在噪声观测和时变传感器故障下的仿真集体导航场景中评估了DGF-Asym。与三个基线方法相比，该方法产生了更稳定的估计结果，并能更可靠地维持决策准则，但代价是更长的决策时间。然而，整体性能取决于故障比例、群体规模以及影响阈值的选择。我们的结果证明了自适应同伴加权在实现稳定的无模型集体估计方面的潜力。
tldr: 提出了一种基于回顾性预测性能进行非对称同伴加权的去中心化集体估计方法DGF-Asym，无需先验噪声统计或故障模型，即可在噪声与故障感知条件下实现更稳定的无模型共识估计。
en_tdlr: DGF-Asym introduces adaptive asymmetric peer weighting based on retrospective predictive performance into the DeGroot-Friedkin model, enabling stable model-free collective estimation under noisy and faulty sensing without prior noise statistics or explicit fault models.
